replies.author: ViceTechnicolour
replies.body:
Hey!

Sorry for the response taking too long, however I didn't really find this map suitable for the server, and we don't intentionally delay responses; it was simply overlooked/forgotten. Thanks for the heads up, however regarding the map, I feel it won't fit.

First of all, we need a download to add it to our servers (which you can upload to Mediafire, Dropbox, MEGA, etc.). A download is needed so we can add it to our repository and see it in rotations, as well as to make YAML (a structural file to show where players spawn and such). 

Second of all, the map itself; It's very small, blocky, and restricted. When playing this for 15 minutes, it isn't really going to be suitable in rotations when each match will be cluttered and walled in. You have very sharp turns, and movement with so many players makes it clustered and hard to actually engage in combat with everyone constantly swinging their sword. If you happened to have a lower player count, it wouldn't be enough for everyone to join in and enjoy. Another issue I found is that when players spawn, you don't get much room to exit which encourages spawnkilling. Due to the map's thin and restricted nature, you will have difficulty fighting back and getting out. 

Unfortunately, I have decided to deny this map. Not sure what you will do to repair it, but the mapdevs are your friends, not enemies. Thanks for contributing to the server!
